segments: Nix is a lazily evaluated functional expression language. Attribute sets and lists are common data structures in configurations, but functions, conditionals, recursion, and evaluation are also part of the language itself.
This is the most important data structure in Nix.
Double quotes are used for single-line strings; two single quotes delimit multiline strings (Indented Strings).
// (Merge): merges two attribute sets. { a = 1; } // { b = 2; } produces { a = 1; b = 2; }.
? (Has Property): checks whether an attribute exists. set ? name returns true/false.
Nix provides many built-in functions that are used frequently in configurations:
builtins.elem x list: checks whether x is in the list.
: although not built in, this is NixOS’s core function library.
In Nix, attribute definitions must end with a semicolon.
